rules.statement: Title will pass only on publication of the gazette by the commission as required by Section 20 of the Land Reform Law.
rules.supporting_quote: Therefore when the Statutory Determination is made and the Gazette Notification is published, the person in whose favour the said Determination was made would become the owner of the land stipulated in the said Statutory Determination.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 20 of the Land Reform Law
